standard_prerequisites.name: Simplicial face-map relations
standard_prerequisites.use: the identities d^1_1 d^2_2 = d^1_1 d^2_1, d^1_1 d^2_0 = d^1_0 d^2_2, d^1_0 d^2_0 = d^1_0 d^2_1 that make the cocycle condition on alpha well defined.

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent datum construction pattern
standard_prerequisites.use: the tau^n_i and tau^n_{ij} degeneracy maps and the quasi-inverse construction pattern borrowed for sheaves on the simplicial site.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 2560-2577): in Situation situation-simplicial-site, the category of cartesian sheaves of sets (resp. abelian groups) on C_total is equivalent to the category of pairs (F, alpha) where F is a sheaf of sets (resp. abelian groups) on C_0 and alpha: (d^1_1)^{-1}F -> (d^1_0)^{-1}F is an isomorphism on C_1 satisfying the cocycle condition (d^2_1)^{-1}alpha = (d^2_0)^{-1}alpha composed with (d^2_2)^{-1}alpha on C_2.

Functor construction (proof lines 2579-2609): the face-map relations (in-source remark) make the cocycle condition meaningful; from a cartesian sheaf G one takes F = G_0 and alpha the composite (d^1_1)^{-1}G_0 -> G_1 <- (d^1_0)^{-1}G_0, whose arrows are invertible because G is cartesian.

Quasi-inverse (lines 2610-2640): borrowing the tau notation from Descent, a pair (F, alpha) yields G_n = (f_{tau^n_n})^{-1}F, and for each phi: [n] -> [m] the map G(phi) is defined through the displayed string of canonical identifications and alpha; this construction is functorial and the two composites are canonically isomorphic to the identities, giving the equivalence.
proof_roadmap: Read the cocycle condition off the simplicial face relations.
Extract (F, alpha) from a cartesian sheaf via its level-one isomorphisms.
Rebuild a simplicial sheaf from (F, alpha) using the tau degeneracies and alpha-gluing.
Check functoriality and conclude the two constructions are quasi-inverse.
difficulty_reason: Equivalence lemma (statement 2560-2577, proof 2579-2640): characterizes cartesian sheaves on the total simplicial site as descent data - the proof is fully constructive: face relations justify alpha, a cartesian sheaf yields the datum through its level-one isomorphisms, and the quasi-inverse rebuilds G_n from the tau degeneracies with the cocycle gluing; every construction and verification is in-span. H2.
